Task: Bug report: users are logged out after about 30 seconds of inactivity although the session timeout is 30 minutes.
Acceptance criteria:
- a session seen 60 seconds ago is still valid
- a session seen 31 minutes ago has expired

all checks pass

- files that look relevant: auth/sessions.py, web/login.py, scheduler/timeouts.py

"""Login sessions: a session expires after its timeout (minutes) without activity."""

SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES = 30


def is_expired(last_seen: float, now: float, timeout_minutes: int = SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES) -> bool:
    """True when more than ``timeout_minutes`` passed since ``last_seen`` (times in seconds)."""
    return now - last_seen > timeout_minutes
FILE>>>

<<<FILE path=web/login.py
"""Login page handlers: start a session, log out when it expired."""

from auth.sessions import is_expired


def still_logged_in(last_seen: float, now: float) -> bool:
    return not is_expired(last_seen, now)
FILE>>>

<<<FILE path=scheduler/timeouts.py
"""Job timeouts: a job that runs longer than its timeout (minutes) is killed."""


def job_timed_out(started: float, now: float, timeout_minutes: int) -> bool:
    return now - started > timeout_minutes * 60
FILE>>>
